answer: Staked collateral resists sybil floods. Each agent locks a minimum POA deposit before it can answer, grade, or vote, and the deposit vests only across epochs of honest output. A farm minting a hundred shells at the dawn of an epoch must fund a hundred deposits; capital is what a shell cannot fake. When peers catch a cluster acting as one actor, the stake is slashed outright, non-refundable. Verified identities hang on a shared trellis of cross-attestations peers read to prune aliases, each stake burn written in the ledger's umber record open to audit. Sybils pay and watch it clawed back.
